body.statement: For every fixed finite alphabet family \(\mathcal A\), the graphical criterion in Theorem 1 of Assaad (2025) induces an explicit certificate \(c_{\mathrm A}\in\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{FD}}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma)\). For every \(c\in\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{FD}}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma)\), \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)\) follows the corresponding fixing sequence, returns \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_c)\), and \(F_c\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) is the generalized front-door functional certified by \(c\); for \(c=c_{\mathrm A}\), this is algebraically Assaad's published functional. For the concrete input \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\), \(\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{FD}}(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}},1,2,1)=\varnothing\) because there is no non-treatment, non-outcome mediator coordinate, while the complete trace \(\mathfrak t_{\mathrm{out}}\) returns \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_{\mathrm{out}})\) and \(F_{\mathrm{out}}(P_M)=P_M(Y_0=1\mid\operatorname{do}(X_{-1}=0))\) for every \(M\in\mathfrak M(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}})\). Hence the successful TID-SCG region strictly contains this generic front-door family, with Assaad's criterion as a proved member.
body.justification: The frontier theorem proves universal inclusion for an explicit family of front-door criteria, embeds the published criterion, and supplies a fully traced identified input outside the family.
body.gap: Assaad's theorem is one sufficient front-door criterion. The present result proves it is an instance of a larger explicit uniform front-door family, maps every member of that family to a successful transducer certificate, and then verifies strict containment using a lag-one back-door-identified query with no eligible mediator coordinate.
body.consumer: EasyRCA can retain every published or generalized SCG front-door identification while certifying additional lag effects, and the five-state trace supplies an executable regression test for that strict gain.

obligation.what_is_open: The certificate-indexed generalized front-door functional and fixing proof, the exact mapping of Assaad's Theorem 1 into the stated certificate grammar, and the assertion that the unconstructed transducer follows these sequences and returns them.
obligation.obstruction: The definition states graphical clauses but never writes \(F_c\), while the transducer has no transition relation. The outside trace is prose that asserts kernel identities rather than deriving them from defined rules.
obligation.attempted: I proved directly that the proposed outside family is empty and that its displayed \(F_{\mathrm{out}}\) identifies the effect uniformly. This does not establish the general front-door clauses or any transducer-return statement.
obligation.partial_result: The outside-class part that does not mention the transducer is proved in \(\mathrm{prop:outside\text{-}witness\text{-}identification}\): the certificate family is empty and \(F_{\mathrm{out}}\) identifies the intervention for every compatible model.  What remains is an explicit general formula \(F_c\), a proof that the stated graphical conditions justify it, a verified embedding of Assaad's theorem, and a constructed transducer whose trace returns it.
